title: 第19章 海龙群第20章 破浪号
lines: 在墨黑色的巨浪中疯狂摇摆，像片脆弱的树叶。
卡拉斯站在剧烈颠簸的船尾，覆盖着象牙白色材质的双脚如同焊接在湿滑甲板上，稳得惊人。
狂风裹挟着冰冷的咸腥雨水，鞭子般抽打船身。
水手们需要死死抓住缆绳才能站稳，卡拉斯却不需要。
这具星辉之躯将海浪的狂暴精准转化为冰冷的数据流，直接灌入他的意识：左舷浪高十米，冲击力峰值…第三肋板应力集中…
没有恐惧，没有眩晕，只有绝对的、非人的稳定。
独眼船长像头发狂的熊，死死把住湿漉漉的舵轮，独眼透过雨幕死死盯向前方沸腾的海平线，黄牙咬得咯吱响，咆哮声在风浪中炸开：
想被那黑寡妇吞了当点心吗？！
水手们在他的吼声中拼命，在湿滑甲板上跌撞奔跑，拉扯绳索，调整风帆，动作带着亡命徒的狠劲和默契。
粗重的喘息和更粗野的回应交织：
每个水手的动作效率，“分析”
绳索何时将断，却无法理解他们脸上那种赌上性命的狠厉，无法理解独眼眼中混合恐惧与亢奋的火焰。
星辉之躯在他与这些活生生挣扎的人之间，筑起了冰冷的高墙。
独眼船长的咆哮猛地砸向他，带着毫不掩饰的烦躁，“别他妈杵着当船首像！
content_en:
The wind changed.
"The Wavebreaker"
Swinging wildly in the black waves, like a fragile leaf.
Karas stood on the violently bumpy stern of the ship, his feet covered in ivory white material seemed to be welded to the slippery deck, astonishingly stable.
The strong wind carried the cold, salty rainwater, whipping the hull of the ship like a whip.
The timber groaned and the chains screeched.
Sailors had to hold on to the cables to stay steady, but Karras didn't.
This starry body accurately converted the violent waves into an icy data flow, directly pouring it into his consciousness: The wave on the port side was ten meters high, and the impact force was at its peak... The stress on the third floor was concentrated...
No fear, no dizziness, just absolute, inhuman stability.
He tilted his head slightly.
The one-eyed captain was like a crazed bear, holding on to the wet steering wheel, staring through the rain curtain at the boiling sea level ahead, his yellow teeth clenched, and his roar exploded in the wind and waves:
"Left full rudder!
Left full rudder!
Do you want to be eaten by that black widow as a snack? !
First mate!
Reef the mainsail!
Fuck!
Want to be torn apart by the wind and fed to the fish? !
Hold on!
Keep it all fucking tight for me! "
His curses are war songs.
The sailors fought hard under his roar, stumbling and running on the slippery deck, pulling ropes and adjusting sails, with the fierceness and tacit understanding of desperadoes in their movements.
Heavy breathing and rougher responses intertwined:
"Left full rudder!
Damn it! "
“The mainsail is furled!
This rag is falling apart! "
Karas watched silently.
He can "calculate"
Movement efficiency of each sailor, "Analysis"
When the rope is about to break, I can't understand the fierceness on their faces that are risking their lives, and I can't understand the fire mixed with fear and excitement in the one-eyed eyes.
The body of starlight built a high, cold wall between him and these people who were struggling.
"Hey!
Stone man! "
The one-eyed captain roared at him fiercely, with undisguised annoyance, "Don't fucking use it as a ship's bow!"
Go to the bow!
Stare at the ‘seal’!
There's something wrong with that black water ahead!
It's like something is stirring the shit down there! "
title_en: Chapter 19 Sea Dragons Chapter 20 Breaking Waves
